config.notes: UTAS course pages (www.utas.edu.au/courses/<college>/courses/<code>-<slug>), one course per page, Domestic and International views both in the HTML (2027 course year). The international panel starts at CRICOS : <code>, then Duration and Location; Location lists campus + study periods (e.g. Hobart Semester 1, Semester 2). term_months from the published study periods https://www.utas.edu.au/key-dates/2026-study-periods and https://www.utas.edu.au/key-dates/2027-study-periods: Semester 1 Feb, Semester 2 Jul, Summer Jan, Winter Jun, Trimester/Spring Nov, AMC MT Main Block 1 Feb, AMC MT Main Block 3 Jun, AMC MT Post Block 4 Nov. IPC (Foundation/pathway) periods are excluded from intakes (IPC Semester 1 Feb, IPC Semester 2 Jun, IPC Semester 3 Oct) because the generic Semester 2 key would give July. Fee = <year> annual international student tuition fee: $X AUD (annual for the course standard year, which can be under 100 credit points, e.g. AMC 57 cp, C7U 75 cp, 54D 133 cp); short courses print <year> Total Tuition Fee (international students) ... based on a rate of $Y AUD per standard full-time year: Y is read; foundation programs print a rate of $0 and are not read. IELTS from course-specific English Language Requirements text where printed; else central rule https://www.utas.edu.au/study/apply/admission-requirements/english-language-requirements.
